notes.title: April 21 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players:
  We're sorry that the official version of the game that was previously released had some problems and brought you an unappetising playing experience. We have optimised the game and the official version has been released. (If you have already installed the game, please uninstall it and reinstall it again.)
  Good luck with the game! Happy Easter!
                                               -- Slowicrowi Studio
